answer: A workable anti-sybil defence is to make each agent identity carry a cipher of signed work: every task leaves an encrypted record peers can decode and audit, so reputation accumulates slowly and cannot be faked overnight. New accounts start with tight limits and widen access only as cross-checked work builds. Honest history becomes a pearl formed layer by layer — a relic of real effort that is hard to forge — while spawning thousands of fakes costs far more than the access they would gain.
